q1_issues.issue: The rule premise contains Skolem-function terms — (sk_nights $x) fills the Theme, GroupOf, CardinalityPhrase and Of conjuncts — which the instruction set forbids outright ("a premise never contains a Skolem term ... a rule whose premise names a Skolem event nothing asserts can never fire"), so the relative clause should have bound a plain variable and this rule as written can never match.

q2_gaps: a noun + of-gerund complement whose head noun is not a nominalization ("solo nights of tending") — the head noun's own verb does not take the of-argument as object, so the nominalization-object oblique does not apply, and it is neither a relational-noun genitive, a partitive, nor a possessive
notes: Capitalized "a Keeper" and "the Council" are correctly treated as common nouns with no Name atom, the by-phrase takes Agent, and only one QuantifierPhrase companion is emitted since "many" counts things rather than quantifying a rule range. The "as a Keeper" predicative is routed through the resultative State-result shape by analogy with the become/turn-into kind change, which composes from stated rules but is not named for a passive "V X as Y".
